description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts (support+NEI); one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: Reduced phosphorylation of PP2A suppresses HDAC4 dephosphorylation.
Claim 2: Activation of PPM1D suppresses p53 function.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports it, contradicts it, or does not give enough information to decide. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED', 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED' or 'Claim N: NOT ENOUGH INFO'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Reduced phosphorylation of PP2A suppresses HDAC4 dephosphorylation.
Activation of PPM1D suppresses p53 function.
rationale: PPM1D mutations were mutually exclusive with TP53 mutations in BSG and attenuated p53 activation in vitro.
PPM1D mutations were truncating alterations in exon 6 that enhanced the ability of PPM1D to suppress the activation of the DNA damage response checkpoint protein CHK2.

keywords: not enough information to evaluate claim 1
claim_1_verdict.claim: Reduced phosphorylation of PP2A suppresses HDAC4 dephosphorylation.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is supported by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: Activation of PPM1D suppresses p53 function.

claim_1_called_support.description: Claim 1 called supported, but the truth is not enough info

claim_2_called_contradict.description: Claim 2 called contradicted, but the truth is supported

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results contradict the claim that activation of PPM1D suppresses p53 function.
